question: National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005. It promises ___________ days of guaranteed wage employment to all rural households in India who volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
solution:
The correct answer is __**100 days**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005 promises **100 days** of guaranteed wage employment to all rural households in India who volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• This act aims to enhance the livelihood security of people in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• The work provided under this scheme includes activities like water conservation, land development, afforestation, and rural connectivity among others.
 
• It is one of the largest work guarantee programs in the world and has been a key instrument in reducing rural poverty and unemployment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The act was notified on **5th September 2005** and was implemented in phases across India.
 
• This scheme is now known as the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**.
 
• MGNREGA covers all districts of India except for those that have a hundred percent urban population.
 
• It also aims to create durable assets and strengthen the livelihood resource base of the rural poor.
 
• The scheme plays a crucial role in promoting inclusive growth by providing employment opportunities to the marginalized sections of society, including women, SC/STs, and other disadvantaged groups.
